flow_classification_retention_full_histo: A configured delete-after value can purge whole Flow runs and step history. Minimum-retention and no-purge values only preserve data. Debug-evidence redaction is configured separately.
flow_classification_retention_security_d: Security classifications are disabled, but saved Flow retention policies still apply to spaces that keep classification ids.
flow_classification_retention_tighten_hi: A matching classification delete-after value can activate automatic deletion. Minimum-retention and no-purge values never activate it. The organization value and any shorter Space or Flow values determine the effective delete-after period.

flow_retention_run_history_description: Leave empty to turn off the organization activator, or set how many days completed Flow run and step history is retained. A matching classification can also activate deletion; Space and Flow values only shorten the effective period.
flow_retention_minimum_description: A mandatory minimum for run history and never-attached uploads. It never activates deletion; the longer organization or matching-classification minimum wins.
flow_retention_no_purge_description: Block automatic purge for Flow run history and never-attached uploads without activating deletion.
flow_retention_upload_description: Leave empty for Off, or set when runtime uploads that were never attached to a run input become eligible for cleanup.
flow_retention_validation_integer: Enter a whole number of days.
flow_retention_validation_range: Enter a value from {min} to {max} days, or leave empty for Off.
flow_retention_preservation_hold_caveat: Deletion is deferred for undelivered audit delivery, unresolved webhook delivery, and active rerun work. The preview reports these blockers separately.
flow_retention_classification_hint: Security-classification policies use the same exact preview and confirmation gate. Existing Space and Flow retention values remain latent while the organization and classification envelope is Off.
flow_retention_preview_description: This fresh, read-only preview compares current and proposed eligibility under the exact policy. The policy is rejected if this evidence changes before confirmation.
flow_retention_preview_latent_values: Latent Space values: {spaces} days. Latent Flow values: {flows} days.
flow_retention_preview_acknowledgement: I reviewed current and proposed eligibility and understand how this change affects deletion and preservation.
flow_retention_effective_description: Run-history deletion is active only when an organization or classification delete-after value is configured. Barrier-only classification policies never activate deletion. Never-attached upload cleanup is active only when the organization upload policy is configured.
flow_retention_clock_description: The exact clock fields are shown again in every destructive-change preview.
flow_retention_run_anchor_description: Run history is anchored to finished_at, falling back to created_at when no finish time exists.
flow_retention_upload_anchor_description: Never-attached uploads are anchored to created_at.
flow_retention_audit_description: Each confirmed policy change records the administrator identity, old and new policy, sanitized preview summary, and change time in the audit log.
flow_knowledge_evidence_intro: Every source a step retrieved from is always listed with its name and counts. The settings below only control how much verbatim text is kept as evidence.
flow_knowledge_evidence_passage_bytes_de: Longer passages are recorded shortened, and the missing end is stated explicitly.
flow_knowledge_evidence_passages_per_sou: The highest-scoring passages are recorded first.
flow_knowledge_evidence_run_view_bytes_d: A shared ceiling for the whole run when evidence is displayed. A run has no attempt limit, so this bounds how much text one view materialises. Sources and counts are always shown.
flow_knowledge_evidence_sources_descript: Remaining sources still show their name, id and match counts, but without recorded text.
flow_knowledge_evidence_step_bytes_descr: A shared ceiling for the whole step, including steps that run once per document.
ai_builder_limits_conversation_budget_de: Tokens reserved for the active conversation after the Builder prompt, tools, output, and safety buffer. Attachment material uses the remaining model context fairly across files.
ai_builder_limits_max_attachments_descri: Maximum attachments retained in one Builder session. There is no separate DOCX or template count limit; the selected model determines how much extracted text can be read.
ai_builder_limits_max_message_chars_desc: Maximum characters in one Builder instruction or refinement. The composer displays and enforces this same effective value.
ai_builder_limits_safety_buffer_descript: Input tokens held back for provider token-count differences and request framing.
ai_builder_limits_template_bytes_descrip: Maximum combined uncompressed DOCX content inspected for template placeholders in one session. This protects synchronous parsing work and is independent of the number of small templates.
ai_builder_limits_template_file_ceiling_: Each DOCX must also stay within {maxBytes} unpacked and {maxEntries} archive entries. Invalid or oversized templates are rejected before model work.
ai_builder_limits_planning_state_ceiling: Persisted attachment evidence must also fit within the system's {value} planning-state ceiling so Builder sessions remain resumable.
ai_builder_limits_template_placeholders_: Maximum unique placeholders inspected across the session's DOCX files. This bounds parsing and persisted planning evidence without coupling template discovery to document-render object limits.
flow_input_limits_audio_description: Set upload limits for audio inputs used by flow transcription steps. Leave empty to use the deployment default.
flow_input_limits_audio_max_files_descri: Maximum number of audio files a single flow run can transcribe. Leave empty to use the default limit.
flow_input_limits_admin_description: Configure upload size and file count limits for published flow runs, including browser audio recordings.
flow_input_limits_file_description: Set upload limits for files that can be attached to a flow run. Leave empty to use the deployment default.
flow_input_limits_max_files_description: Maximum number of uploaded files a single flow run can use. Leave empty for no limit.

flow_run_knowledge_view_attempts_not_loa: {count} attempts were not loaded in this view. Current attempts are prioritized, and evidence for the remaining attempts is retained.
flow_run_knowledge_view_corrupt_passage_: Recorded passage-size evidence is unreadable for {count} attempts. Their retrieval evidence is not shown, and they are included in the not-loaded count. Evidence export is unavailable until the stored evidence is repaired.
flow_run_knowledge_view_current_attempts: Current retrieval evidence for {count} steps could not be loaded within this view's limits. Known affected steps include {steps}. Their evidence is retained; an empty trace on those steps must not be read as them having none.
flow_run_evidence_view_rows_omitted: {count} retained {section} rows are not shown because this view reached its row limit.
flow_run_evidence_view_bytes_omitted: {count} retained {section} rows are not shown because this view reached its size limit.
flow_run_evidence_view_parent_omitted: {count} retained {section} rows are not shown because their parent records were omitted.
flow_run_export_recovery_evidence_view: The run holds more evidence than one export can contain. Open the run's evidence view, which shows what fits and says exactly what it left out.
flow_run_export_recovery_provider_calls: The run has too many provider calls for one export. Open the run's provider-call list, which shows them a page at a time.
flow_run_step_current_evidence_not_loade: This step's current knowledge evidence was not loaded in this view. It is retained — an empty trace here does not mean the step retrieved nothing.
